departments.name: Literature & Novelty
departments.charter: Maps prior work, verifies every citation, and states exactly how this work differs.

departments.name: Methodology
departments.charter: Hypotheses, baselines, ablations, metrics, splits and statistics that survive peer review and fit the owner's hardware.

departments.name: Experiments
departments.charter: Reproducible, memory-safe implementations and runs; never reports a result that was not run.

departments.name: Analysis
departments.charter: Correct statistics, honest effect sizes, publication-quality figures.

departments.name: Writing
departments.charter: Manuscripts, rebuttals and grants within venue limits, every claim mapped to evidence.

departments.name: Outreach
departments.charter: Cold emails to collaborators, authors, labs and data owners; venue and funding scouting. Drafts only.

departments.name: Ethics & Compliance
departments.charter: Data licences, human-subjects/IRB, dual-use, authorship and disclosure.
